user.title: Connect to a Burnham ALTA boiler
user.description: Choose how this Home Assistant instance reaches the boiler. The integration is read-only.

tcp.title: Modbus TCP gateway
tcp.description: Enter the host and port of a gateway that translates Modbus TCP (MBAP) to the boiler's RTU link. This integration does not support RTU-over-TCP framing. It sends only function 03 reads.

serial.title: Direct serial RTU
serial.description: Enter the serial device path. Prefer the stable /dev/serial/by-id/... path for the adapter (for example the FTDI by-id entry) when one exists; /dev/ttyUSB0 also works. Communication is fixed at 38400 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit (8-N-1). The integration sends only function 03 reads.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the boiler or gateway.
error.modbus_error: The Modbus device returned an error response.
error.invalid_response: The device replied, but not with the expected eight registers.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This boiler connection is already configured.

init.title: Burnham ALTA options
init.description: Choose how often Home Assistant reads the boiler. The integration is read-only.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between reads, from 5 to 3600. The default is 10 seconds.

error.invalid_scan_interval: Enter a whole number of seconds between 5 and 3600.
